edits.new:
Its path and merge order are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0394; ASM-0569).

Contract shapes in `05 Technical architecture/Recovery Workbench API Specification v4.yaml`: GET `/treatments/{treatmentId}/credit-pack` answers `CreditPack` (`caseNo`, `productGroup`, `accounts`, `collateral`, `terms`, `requiredLevel`, `documents`, `messages`). GET `/treatments/{treatmentId}/credit-result` answers `CreditResult` (`creditDecisionKey`, `accountKey`, `nleadsRef`, `result`, `reason`, `decidedAt`, `sourceSystem`, `dataAsOf`), read through `v_ace_credit_decision`, and returns 404 MSG-P3-024 until ACE holds a decision. The treatment carries the read-only fields `nleadsRef`, `creditResult`, `creditResultReason` and `creditResultAt`. The decision paths are POST `/approvals/{approvalId}/approve`, `/return` and `/refuse`, with request `ApprovalAction`; approve answers `DecisionLogEntry`.

The rwb-case login name: Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0729). The rwb-decision login name, the delegation read and its answer shape, the actions payload keys, the owner of the level comparison, the message texts of this slice, the decision sub-code and the screen identity: Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1342).

Approval levels rank from L1, the highest authority, downwards (FSD P4 AC-EXC-P4-006-01; FSD P7 AC-EXC-P7-015-05). A result at level L5 therefore meets a plan that needs level L6 or higher, and a result at level L6 does not meet a plan that needs level L5.
